skills.name: Solve panda / robotic manipulation
skills.procedure: Use SAC with policy='MlpPolicy'; read max_episode_steps from env.spec and set learning_starts >= that value; each optimization iteration resume from the checkpoint (SAC.load + load_replay_buffer, learn one ~150k chunk, then save model + replay buffer).
skills.pitfalls: Commit to one algorithm so checkpoint-resume accumulates.
